svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.text: What the memory is made of
one 16 GiB node per client · what the runtime reports (stacked) under the container's anonymous memory (line) · GiB
the gap between the stack and the line is memory outside the runtime: page caches and native allocations · yellow = XEN load · red = fork
Nethermind's RocksDB index and filter blocks for the second tree are ~3 GiB on top of the flat state's; geth's heap grows with the load; after the fork one
tree's worth of memory is gone.
